entries.en: Fixed Fable 5 model names with a `[1m]` suffix not being normalized — Fable 5 includes 1M context by default, so the suffix is now stripped automatically
entries.zh: 修复了带有`[1m]`后缀的《神鬼寓言 5》模型名称未标准化的问题 - 《神鬼寓言 5》默认包含 1M 上下文，因此现在会自动删除后缀

entries.en: Fixed a spurious "sandbox dependencies missing" startup warning on Windows when sandbox was enabled in settings
entries.zh: 修复了在设置中启用沙箱时 Windows 上虚假的“沙箱依赖项缺失”启动警告
